description: A thing the API exposes, addressed by a URL with a plural noun (`/projects/42`). Methods act on it; the URL never contains the verb.
Sent with `201 Created` to point at the new resource (`Location: /projects/43`).
Success without a body, typical for `DELETE`. Send it with `c.body(null, 204)`.
The request is valid but clashes with the current state: duplicate unique field, stale version, invalid state transition.
Repeating the request leaves the server in the same state. `GET`, `PUT` and `DELETE` are idempotent; `POST` is not, unless you add an `Idempotency-Key`.
`PATCH` changes the fields you send; `PUT` replaces the whole representation.
